title: Stage
description:

Wheel alignment
Diagnostics

rounds.aiContent: Add two new stages to the photo stage-grouping used across the app — Wheel alignment and Diagnostics — alongside the existing Check-in, Quote, Progress, Checkout, and Extra, so photos taken during those parts of a job get filed under their own heading instead of being lumped into Extra.

questions.prompt: Is this the right idea: adding "Wheel alignment" and "Diagnostics" as two new stages alongside Check-in, Quote, Progress, Checkout, and Extra?

options.label: Close, but not quite -- see my comment
